transport layers, interface recombination, contact chemistry and the film

turns.answer_text:
Inverted MAPbI3 wants a hydrophobic, well-aligned HTL (PTAA/PMMA, P3CT-Na, NiMgLiO), a cascaded fullerene/NFA ETL plus a hole-blocking buffer (BCP/Bphen), and a chemically quiet cathode (Cu, or Al only with Bphen).

c030 is almost the 19.48 PTAA|PMMA / PCBM|Bphen / Al cell with an extra IDTT2FPDI cascade; PMMA cuts interface recombination and Bphen makes Al ohmic. c044 is the canonical ITO/PTAA/PCBM/BCP/Cu stack (Cu avoids AgI; analogs 18.6–19.1%). c097 is the 18.49 ITCPTC-Th/P3CT-Na device with Se-NFA (deeper LUMO, better extraction). c041 is Chen-type FTO/NiMgLiO (Li raises WF, Mg kills Ni3+ traps) with PCBM/BCP/Ag (~18.2 analog). c058 keeps P3CT-Na with a C60:PDI/BCP ETL (NDP-V analog 17.6–18.5%).

Final: c030, c044, c097, c041, c058

    for p in s.replace('>>','|').replace(';','|').split('|'):
        p=p.strip()
        if p and p.lower() not in ('none','unknown'):

    return out

    for i,r in df.iterrows():
        ii = i if df is train else i
    X=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        v=np.zeros(len(vocab))
        for c in cols:
            for t in split_toks(r[c]):
                v[inv[t]]=1

    X=np.array(X)
    # also count of layers
    extra=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        extra.append([
            len(split_toks(r['etl'])),
            len(split_toks(r['htl'])),
            len(split_toks(r['backcontact'])),
            int('Spin-coating'==r['deposition']),

    # HTL

    if 'PEDOT:PSS' in htl and 'PTAA' not in htl and 'NiO' not in htl: s+=0.2
    if htl.lower()=='none': s-=0.5
    # ETL
    if 'BCP' in etl or 'Bphen' in etl: s+=1.5
    if 'C60' in etl: s+=1.0
    if 'PCBM-60' in etl: s+=0.6
    if 'ITCPTC' in etl: s+=1.4
    if 'IDTT' in etl or 'PDI' in etl or 'NDP' in etl: s+=0.8
    if 'Zr(acac)' in etl: s+=1.2

def split_toks(s):
    s = str(s)
    out=[]
    for p in s.replace('>>','|').replace(';','|').split('|'):
        p=p.strip()
        if p and p.lower() not in ('none','unknown'):
            out.append(p)
    return out

# Build vocabulary of tokens
vocab=sorted({t for df in (train,pool) for c in cols for s in df[c] for t in split_toks(s)})
print('vocab', len(vocab))

def featurize(df):
    n=len(df)
    # token one-hot
    X = np.zeros((n, len(vocab)))
    inv={t:i for i,t in enumerate(vocab)}
    for i,r in df.iterrows():
        ii = i if df is train else i
    X=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        v=np.zeros(len(vocab))
        for c in cols:
            for t in split_toks(r[c]):
                v[inv[t]]=1
        X.append(v)
    X=np.array(X)
    # also count of layers
    extra=[]
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        extra.append([
            len(split_toks(r['etl'])),
            len(split_toks(r['htl'])),
            len(split_toks(r['backcontact'])),
            int('Spin-coating'==r['deposition']),

    if 'C60' in etl: s+=1.0
    if 'PCBM-60' in etl: s+=0.6
    if 'ITCPTC' in etl: s+=1.4
    if 'IDTT' in etl or 'PDI' in etl or 'NDP' in etl: s+=0.8
    if 'Zr(acac)' in etl: s+=1.2

    # substrate
